label: Roezan SMS
description: Send SMS and MMS, manage contacts, lists and tags, and automate broadcasts

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Queue one SMS or MMS; acknowledgement does not confirm delivery.

operations.name: list_senders
operations.description: Read the account's sending phone numbers.

operations.name: list_lists
operations.description: Read lists belonging to the account.

operations.name: list_fields
operations.description: Read the account's custom field definitions.

operations.name: list_tags
operations.description: Read tags and the provider's pagination metadata.

operations.name: subscribe_contact
operations.description: Queue creation or subscription of a contact to a list.

operations.name: unsubscribe_contact
operations.description: Queue removal of a contact from a list.

operations.name: upsert_contact
operations.description: Create or update a contact; list and tag changes are asynchronous.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Find a contact by phone, with email as a fallback.

operations.name: add_contact_tags
operations.description: Queue the addition of tags to a contact.

operations.name: remove_contact_tag
operations.description: Queue removal of one tag from a contact.

operations.name: get_contact_messages
operations.description: Read one page of conversation history; pass next_cursor back unchanged.

operations.name: get_broadcast_recipients
operations.description: Read one page of broadcast recipients and delivery results.

operations.name: create_broadcast
operations.description: Create a draft. This operation does not schedule or send the broadcast.

operations.name: preview_broadcast
operations.description: Queue a real test message to one phone from a draft or scheduled broadcast.

operations.name: schedule_broadcast
operations.description: Confirm a draft's stored time, supply a new time, or explicitly send now.

operations.name: cancel_broadcast
operations.description: Cancel a pending broadcast, reverting it to a draft.

operations.name: get_broadcast
operations.description: Read status and delivery, reply and opt-out counts.
